product.title: Award Winning Farm Tour: Coffee, Chocolate and Unique Gifts

description.text: Hawaii is renowned for its coffee and chocolate, and this Kona farm tour takes you behind the scenes of a traditional plantation. Learn how coffee is grown and produced, discover the chocolate-making journey from bean to bar, and have a chance to sample both delicacies. Stops include Kona Coffee Orchard, Coffee Processing Area, Chocolate Making Demonstration, Farm Gift Shop. At the end of the tour, spend as much time as you like browsing unique gifts made from farm ingredients. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
